decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.The proposed first floor side and rear extensions, by reason of their size, bulk, position and appearance results in a highly obtrusive feature that would be unduly detrimental to the original character and design of the dwelling house and the street scene in general.  The extensions do not harmonise with the appearance and character of the surrounding residential dwellings and are detrimental to the visual amenity of the streetscene.  It 	would therefore be contrary to Adopted UDP 2003 Policies ENV-B.1.1	(New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).

Condition : 2 - The proposed first floor side and rear extensions by reason of their size, bulk, positions and appearance results in an over-development of the dwelling house and the western property boundary, creating a significant and detrimental loss of amenity afforded to the No.182 Ellerdine Road the adjacent dwelling located to the north-west.   It would therefore be contrary to Adopted UDP 2003 Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).
description: Erection of first floor side and rear extension to house
